benchmark_boundary: Actual public DefaultHtmlGenerator.GenerateSelect followed by WriteTo(HtmlEncoder.Default) and StringWriter.ToString
tuning_changes: Raise both count gates from 16 to 32 after the first pair's small hit-case time/allocation regression; preserve all first-prototype results and source.
eligibility: Exact List<string> with >=32 entries and materialized exact List<SelectListItem> or SelectListItem[] with >=32 options
normal_path: Actual CollectionModelBinder<string> then GetCurrentValues supplies an existing case-insensitive HashSet; it remains non-indexed.
correctness_boundary: All 32 full encoded HTML oracle receipts agree in before, first prototype and final builds; all eight new test outcomes and all 2601 owning outcomes pass in every source variant.
producer_reachability: The permanent lazy-enumeration and custom-indexer tests invoke those real option producers before/during membership; the benchmark setup also invokes the actual binder/GetCurrentValues producers.
timing_limit: Lazy/indexer updates occur during the first setup render; timing measures their established steady input, not a fresh mutation on every iteration.
indexer_control_limit: The identical measured Indexer control retains Moq invocations. An untimed final-snapshot actual-render diagnostic observes 131 additional retained calls per render and storage growth from capacity 256 to 16384 across 64 renders. This is not a steady-state allocation control and its measured 44145 B/op increase in round 3 is not quantitatively attributed or dismissed. All raw results remain; no indexer performance improvement is claimed.
array_control_limit: Array_1024_512 is intentionally not indexed and has highly variable original means/SDs. Its apparent final median improvement is not attributed to this optimization; all eight samples and the large original round-3 SD are retained.
runtime_limit: Pinned prerelease .NET 12 SDK/runtime, BenchmarkDotNet 0.13.0, in-process server GC, shared Windows host, serial measurements; not production throughput.
test_limit: Compatibility evidence is not functional bug-fix red/green proof; no browser/hosted application or concurrent mutation test.
source_capture_limit: Immutable manifests truthfully retain the baseline HEAD and dirty source/test/report state at capture; final commit is verified separately by source hashes.
documentation: Current IHtmlGenerator.GenerateSelect XML documentation permits arbitrary caller-provided ICollection<string>; narrow GitHub searches did not identify an overlap and are not an exhaustive-coverage claim.
